purpose: Part 1/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 029; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the current 130-record checkpoint.

items/amber-amulet-of-vermin.name: Amber Amulet of Vermin
items/amber-amulet-of-vermin.effectSummary: Single-use: break the amulet to release its trapped vermin, which immediately grows as though affected by giant vermin. Roll 1d8 for the stored creature: 1 giant bee (CL 7), 2 giant ant queen (CL 10), 3 giant praying mantis (CL 10), 4 Huge monstrous centipede (CL 10), 5 Large monstrous scorpion (CL 10), 6 Large monstrous spider (CL 10), 7 giant wasp (CL 13), or 8 giant stag beetle (CL 19).

items/amber-amulet-vermin-all-509.name: Amber Amulet of Vermin (All)
items/amber-amulet-vermin-all-509.effectSummary: Once per day as a standard command activation, the amulet summons its designated giant vermin for 1 minute; it obeys the user and then vanishes. Versions are giant bee (CL 7), giant queen ant (CL 10), giant praying mantis (CL 10), Huge monstrous centipede (CL 10), Huge monstrous scorpion (CL 10), Large monstrous spider (CL 10), giant wasp (CL 15), and giant stag beetle (CL 19).

items/bag-of-holding.name: Bag of Holding
items/bag-of-holding.effectSummary: Four versions retain fixed carried weight while filled: Type I weighs 15 lb. and holds 250 lb./30 cu. ft.; Type II 25 lb. and 500 lb./70 cu. ft.; Type III 35 lb. and 1,000 lb./150 cu. ft.; Type IV 60 lb. and 1,500 lb./250 cu. ft. It opens into nondimensional storage. If overloaded or pierced by a sharp object, it ruptures and is ruined and all contents are lost forever. Turning it inside out spills the contents harmlessly, but it must be righted before reuse. Living creatures inside have 10 minutes of air before suffocating. Retrieving a specific item is a move action unless the contents exceed an ordinary backpack, in which case it is a full-round action. Putting a bag of holding inside a portable hole destroys both in an Astral rift; putting a portable hole inside the bag destroys both and draws the bag, hole, and creatures within 10 feet to the Astral Plane.

items/bag-of-tricks.name: Bag of Tricks
items/bag-of-tricks.effectSummary: Removing a fuzzy ball and throwing it up to 20 feet creates a random animal that serves for 10 minutes, until slain, or until ordered back into the bag, then disappears. Only one summoned animal can exist at a time and at most ten can be drawn per week. Gray results: bat 01-30, rat 31-60, cat 61-75, weasel 76-90, badger 91-100. Rust results: wolverine 01-30, wolf 31-60, boar 61-85, black bear 86-100. Tan results: brown bear 01-30, lion 31-60, warhorse 61-80, tiger 81-90, rhinoceros 91-100.

items/bag-tricks-gray-125.name: Bag of Tricks, Gray
items/bag-tricks-gray-125.effectSummary: Removing a fuzzy ball and throwing it up to 20 feet creates a random animal that serves for 10 minutes, until slain, or until ordered back into the bag, then disappears and can follow normal Handle Animal commands. Only one summoned animal can exist at a time and at most ten can be drawn per week. Results: bat 01-30, rat 31-60, cat 61-75, weasel 76-90, badger 91-100.

items/carpet-of-flying.name: Carpet of Flying
items/carpet-of-flying.effectSummary: A command word spoken within voice range activates the carpet; spoken directions then control its unlimited-duration flight. Versions are 3×5 ft., 300 lb. capacity, 210-ft. speed; 4×6 ft., 600 lb., 180 ft.; 5×7 ft., 900 lb., 150 ft.; and 6×9 ft., 1,200 lb., 120 ft.
